notes: Window: the Preamble's seven 'Kwa kuwa' clauses, the proclamation, and Article 1. FULL propositional coverage per R8: 23 rows, up from 15 — the most of the five, because this translation verbs separately several things the others fold: 'born free' vs 'dignity and rights are equal', the proclamation's object as its own copula sentence, and a second Article-adjacent sentence about what all nations will strive to do.
